enable_deidentification.title: Enable Deidentification
enable_deidentification.description: When true, enables de-identification processing for the query before retrieval. PHI/PII entities are replaced with labelled placeholders (e.g. [SSN], [PERSON]) and the de-identified query is used for all downstream steps (vector search, hybrid search, HyDE). The response will include a `deidentification_output` field with the de-identified query text.

LLMRequest.title: LLMRequest
LLMRequest.description: Extended LLMRequest with top_p, temperature, and system_prompt parameter for RAG service.

compatibility_profile.title: Compatibility Profile
compatibility_profile.description: Optional compatibility profile for recreating earlier pipeline behavior.

use_prompt_combiner.description: Configures whether enabled initial pre-retrieval prompt calls are combined into one LLM call and controls the model parameters for that combined call. When disabled, component-level overrides are used. Legacy boolean values remain supported.

query_expansion_model_id.title: Query Expansion Model Id
query_expansion_model_id.description: Optional override for the query expansion plugin model id.

query_expansion_response_mode.title: Query Expansion Response Mode
query_expansion_response_mode.description: Optional override for the query expansion response parsing mode.

query_expansion_count.title: Query Expansion Count
query_expansion_count.description: Optional cap on the number of expanded subqueries. None leaves the count LLM-driven.

guidelines_branch_source.title: Guidelines Branch Source
guidelines_branch_source.description: Selector for the dedicated guidelines retrieval branch. Supported values are 'default' for the current GUIDELINES-tagged corpus and 'NICE' for NICE-tagged guidelines. Omitted, empty, or invalid values fall back to 'default'.

non_guidelines_corpus_mode.title: Non Guidelines Corpus Mode
non_guidelines_corpus_mode.description: Experimental request parameter controlling the corpus used by non-guideline JL retrieval branches. Allowed values: 'default' (current JL corpus) and 'expanded' (current corpus plus candidate-tagged full-text JL articles). Omitted or invalid values fall back to 'default'. This parameter is request-driven and is not environment-gated by the API.

per_lane_caps.title: Per Lane Caps
per_lane_caps.description: Optional per-lane cap: source_key (e.g. main_md_lexical) -> max results that lane may contribute.

lane_priority.title: Lane Priority
lane_priority.description: Optional ordered query_source names floated to the top of the final context before trimming.

apply_aggregated_chunk_deduplication.title: Apply Aggregated Chunk Deduplication
apply_aggregated_chunk_deduplication.description: Override for query-expansion aggregation chunk deduplication.

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: Model id for the combined initial pre-retrieval LLM call. Defaults to the current prompt-combiner model.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature for the combined initial pre-retrieval LLM call. Defaults to the current prompt-combiner temperature.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Top-p for the combined initial pre-retrieval LLM call. Defaults to the current prompt-combiner top-p.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: When true, use this configuration for the combined initial LLM call. When false, ignore the remaining prompt-combiner parameters and use component-level configuration.

prompt_version.title: Prompt Version
prompt_version.description: Optional query interpretation prompt version override.

enable_request_tracing.title: Enable Request Tracing
enable_request_tracing.description: When true, enables request tracing for this /streaming/query call regardless of the server default.

guidelines_branch_source.title: Guidelines Branch Source
guidelines_branch_source.description: Optional top-level alias for orchestration_config.guidelines_branch_source. Only affects the dedicated guidelines retrieval branch.

personalization_setting.title: Personalization Setting
personalization_setting.description: Patient age group personalization setting from user profile

enable_deidentification.title: Enable Deidentification
enable_deidentification.description: When true, enables de-identification processing for the query before retrieval. PHI/PII entities are replaced with labelled placeholders (e.g. [SSN], [PERSON]) and the de-identified query is used for all downstream steps (vector search, hybrid search, HyDE). The response will include a `deidentification_output` field with the de-identified query text.

context_text.title: Context Text
context_text.description: Deprecated. Any supplied value is ignored; sectioned context_text is always built from memory_blocks.

patient_summary.title: Patient Summary
patient_summary.description: Required consolidated EHR-derived case narrative (including recent trajectory), mapped internally to the Summary of stay section.

retrieval_safe_case_frame.title: Retrieval Safe Case Frame
retrieval_safe_case_frame.description: Required short retrieval-safe case frame, including the best initial hypothesis. Mapped internally to the Additional clinician-provided details section.

suggested_retrieval_queries.title: Suggested Retrieval Queries
suggested_retrieval_queries.description: Required client-supplied retrieval queries. Used as the executed query expansion when Stage A falls back to the deterministic path; unsafe queries are dropped with warnings.
